title: Can large language models assist choice modelling? Insights into prompting strategies and current models' capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2507.21790v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are becoming widely used to support various workflows across different disciplines, yet their potential in discrete choice modelling remains relatively unexplored. This work examines the potential of LLMs as assistive agents in the specification and, where technically feasible, estimation of Multinomial Logit models. We implement a systematic experimental framework involving twelve versions of seven leading LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, and Mistral) evaluated under five experimental configurations. These configurations vary along three dimensions: (i) modelling goal (suggesting vs. suggesting and estimating MNL models); (ii) prompting strategy (Zero-Shot vs. Chain-of-Thoughts (CoT)); and (iii) information availability (full dataset vs. data dictionary summarising variable names and types). Each specification suggested by the LLMs is implemented, estimated, and evaluated base

translated_title: 大型语言模型能否辅助选择建模？提示策略与当前模型能力的洞察
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正被广泛用于支持不同学科的各种工作流程，但它们在离散选择建模方面的潜力仍未得到充分探索。本研究考察了LLMs作为辅助代理在多项式Logit模型的规格设定以及（在技术可行时）估计中的潜力。我们实施了一个系统性的实验框架，涉及七个领先LLM（ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek、Gemini、Gemma、Llama和Mistral）的十二个版本，并在五种实验配置下进行评估。这些配置在三个维度上有所不同：（i）建模目标（仅建议 vs. 建议并估计MNL模型）；（ii）提示策略（零样本 vs. 思维链（CoT））；以及（iii）信息可用性（完整数据集 vs. 数据字典，总结变量名称和类型）。每个由LLMs建议的规格都会被实现、估计，并基于此进行评估。
tldr: 本文系统评估了七个主流大型语言模型在离散选择建模中的辅助能力，揭示了提示策略和可用信息对模型规格建议质量的关键影响。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates the assistive capability of seven leading LLMs in discrete choice modeling, revealing the critical impact of prompting strategies and available information on the quality of model specification suggestions.
